title_zh: 逐项测试并记录录音背景噪声

scenario.label_zh: 逐项测试并记录录音背景噪声
scenario.goal_zh: 区分观察到的噪声与尚未确定的原因，并约定单独改变设备状态后记录比较结果

context_zh: 录音室工作人员检查一段八秒试录中的嗡嗡声，尚未确定原因。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Ren
sentences.text: There's a hum in this test recording. It starts just as the printer begins running.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: It could be interference, but the timing alone doesn't prove where it's coming from.

sentences.speaker: Ren
sentences.text: I'll play the eight-second section on a loop so we can hear the change.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Then let's make a fresh recording with the printer switched off and everything else unchanged.

sentences.speaker: Ren
sentences.text: Should I also move the microphone?

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Not in the same test. That would interfere with the comparison. Let's change one thing at a time.

sentences.speaker: Ren
sentences.text: Understood. I'll log the equipment settings and the result for each recording.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Good. We'll compare the first pair before deciding what to test next.
